candidates.change_summary: Change blockAssertion from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy.
Change arbitrateViaEscalationManager from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy.
Change discardOracle from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy.
Change validateDisputers from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy.
Change the return value from true to false.
Insert `return 0;` as the body of getPrice, changing its successful-completion return value from revert behavior to returning 0 (relative to a body that would otherwise not yield a value).
Replace the inserted trivial return with a return derived from the time parameter, so calls with time != 0 return a different value than a constant zero.
Replace the return statement with a return derived from the identifier parameter, so calls with a nonzero identifier return a different value.
Replace the return statement with one derived from ancillaryData length, changing the returned value for non-empty ancillary data.
Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier from requestPrice so anyone can emit PriceRequestAdded, changing observable behavior for non-asserter callers.
Delete the require statement so the modifier no longer restricts callers, allowing requestPrice to succeed for any sender.
Invert the sender check so the modifier rejects calls from the optimistic asserter and allows everyone else, changing observable behavior of requestPrice.
Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier from assertionResolvedCallback so any caller can invoke it without reverting.
Add a revert statement in the body of assertionResolvedCallback so every call to it reverts.
Delete the require statement in the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier so it no longer enforces the caller check, letting arbitrary callers pass through to assertionResolvedCallback.

Invert the require condition in onlyOptimisticAsserter so the modifier permits calls from any address except the optimistic asserter, changing which callers can execute assertionDisputedCallback without reverting.
Change blockAssertion from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy struct.
Change arbitrateViaEscalationManager from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy struct.
Change discardOracle from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy struct.
Change validateDisputers from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy struct.
Change the return statement from `return true;` to `return false;` so isDisputeAllowed denies disputes instead of allowing them.
Change the empty body to return the constant 1 instead of implicitly returning 0.
Return -1 instead of the implicit default 0.
Insert a statement casting an identifier-dependent nonzero value into int256 so the return differs from 0.
Remove the event emission so a requestPrice call no longer records the price request via PriceRequestAdded.
Emit the event with a fixed zero identifier, changing the recorded request data for any call.
Drop the onlyOptimisticAsserter guard so any caller can trigger requestPrice and its observable event.
